page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is an x86_64 server configuration driven by AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. It delivers 90 dedicated vCPUs spanning 45 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory architecture provides 720 GB of total RAM, corresponding to an 8 GB per-vCPU ratio. Cache provisions feature 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster. Advanced CPU instruction sets include AVX-512 with VNNI and bfloat16 support, as well as hardware AES and SHA cryptographic accelerations. No dedicated GPU accelerators are included.

Integrated local storage is configured with 3,216 GB of NVMe SSD capacity spread across 8 local solid-state drives, providing low-latency ephemeral block storage directly to the host. In benchmark evaluations, the multi-core compute throughput achieved top-tier standing in stress-ng multi-core testing (129,175.86) and PassMark CPU evaluations (87,474.24), alongside elevated results in Clang software compilation (60,820.0) and ray tracing tasks. Cryptographic and vector extension workloads also exhibit upper-percentile execution speeds due to native AVX-512 extensions.

The 720 GB memory pool demonstrates strong cached memory read bandwidth reaching 6,368.24 GB/sec and uncached read bandwidth of 217.31 GB/sec, though large-block uncached write bandwidth settles at an average 77.28 GB/sec. Redis operations reach 118.1 million operations per second, supported by fast memory access and high-core parallelization. CPU-based inference workloads perform reliably on small to medium models, though large 70B parameter models remain constrained by the absence of dedicated tensor acceleration.

Qualitatively, this instance achieves favorable resource efficiency for enterprise deployments needing both high thread counts and massive memory footprints alongside rapid scratch disk access. The combination of dense memory allocation, dedicated AMD cores, and fast local NVMe SSD storage makes the instance well suited for in-memory database engines, large analytical caches, distributed data processing, Clang build farms, and high-throughput transactional databases.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-90-lssd is a memory-dense, compute-capable instance featuring 90 dedicated vCPUs from AMD EPYC 9B14 processors across 45 physical cores. The platform integrates 720 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8 GB per-vCPU distribution, paired with 3,216 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across 8 bundled drives. Benchmark results place its multi-core compute, code compilation, and PassMark CPU performance in the top tier, while cached memory reads and database operations demonstrate strong throughput. With integrated AVX-512 vector support and robust cryptographic acceleration, it operates efficiently without discrete GPUs. The substantial memory footprint and high-speed local NVMe capacity position this server well for in-memory databases, large-scale data processing pipelines, distributed caching architectures, and intensive continuous integration build environments.
